advance_clear_all_detection_traces_desc: Удаляет данные приложения детектора, файлы журналов, временные каталоги и очищает системный кэш
advance_kill_all_desc: Принудительная остановка и очистка данных для всех известных детекторов, GMS, пультов дистанционного управления и инструментов
control_toggle_action_pif_desc: Запустить скрипты автоматического обновления для Play Integrity Fix
control_conflicts_desc: ВКЛ = модуль обрабатывает это. ВЫКЛ = Specter обрабатывает это. Удалите конфликтующие модули из вашего корневого менеджера, если возникнут проблемы.

sp_use_device_desc: Read the security patch from the current system build.
sp_fetch_latest_desc: Get the latest date from the Pixel security bulletin.

omk_saved: OMK OS и Boot Key сохранены

custom_kb_file_desc: Выберите XML-файл keybox на своем устройстве

danger_confirm_msg: This action may affect your device. Are you sure?
history_empty: No activity yet - run an action to get started

control_toggle_auto_target_desc: Automatically add new apps to Tricky Store target list

language_subpage_desc: Select display language for Specter WebUI

settings_logs_desc: View terminal output and execution logs
logs_empty_desc: Script execution and terminal output will appear here
tools_danger_zone_desc: Destructive operations that may affect your device
update_desc: Stay up to date with the latest Specter releases and bug fixes.
update_note: Join Telegram or check GitHub for contributions and technical discussions.

control_toggle_rom_fingerprint_desc: Strip custom ROM names, debug build traces, and PIF module properties
rom_fingerprint_custom_props_desc: Delete custom ROM identity props at boot (can break ROM OTAs)
adb_disabler_dialog_desc: Choose which developer settings to disable at boot.
adb_disabler_dev_options_desc: Disables developer options toggle in Settings
adb_disabler_usb_debug_desc: Disables ADB, locks USB config, stops adbd, and locks OEM unlock
adb_disabler_oem_unlock_desc: Hides OEM unlock toggle from developer options
rom_fingerprint_dialog_desc: Clean custom ROM traces, debug build types, and module residue from properties.
rom_fingerprint_hexpatch_desc: Delete any build property containing custom ROM identifiers
rom_fingerprint_prefix_desc: Strip custom ROM prefixes (aosp_, lineage_) from build fingerprint and display id
rom_fingerprint_pif_desc: Remove leftover Play Integrity Fix module properties from build
prop_handler_dialog_desc: Manage boot-time property spoofing and cleanup.
prop_handler_boot_state_desc: Spoof bootloader lock, verified boot, dm-verity, and build signatures
prop_handler_bootmode_desc: Override ro.bootmode to hide that device booted from recovery
prop_handler_spoof_build_desc: Strip userdebug/eng traces from build.flavor and build.fingerprint
gms_dialog_desc: Choose which GMS cleanup actions to run when triggered.
gms_force_stop_desc: Kill droidguard and force-stop Play Store, GMS, GSF, Chrome, SafetyCore, and related GMS processes
gms_clear_data_desc: Run pm clear on Play Store to reset its state
action_sp_dialog_desc: Action tries enabled sources top to bottom and stops at the first valid value.

action_sp_bulletin_desc: Latest date from the Pixel security bulletin
action_sp_synthetic_desc: OMK: latest token; Tricky Store family: 5th of the current month
control_toggle_action_keybox_desc: Download and install a valid keybox

auto_target_method_instant_help: New apps are added as soon as they're installed.
auto_target_method_polling_help: Scans for new apps at a fixed interval.
control_toggle_autopif_desc: Periodically fetch new Play Integrity fingerprints
autopif_desc: Automatically fetches new Play Integrity fingerprints at a set interval.

control_toggle_autokeybox_desc: Periodically fetch a new valid keybox

tools_restart_omk_keymint_desc: Используйте после изменения версии ОС OMK или boot key.
tools_restart_omk_injector_desc: Используйте эту функцию, если изменения в target-app не сохранились, а затем перезапустите приложение.
tools_restart_omk_desc: Restart keymint or injector after OMK changes
settings_dark_theme_desc: Используйте темный фон, чтобы снизить расход заряда аккумулятора и сделать просмотр более комфортным для глаз.
settings_dark_standard_desc: Включает стандартную темную тему для приложения
settings_dark_amoled_desc: Густо-черный фон (#000000) для AMOLED-экранов, позволяющий экономить заряд аккумулятора и повысить контрастность

menu_pif_random_desc: Randomly emulate any Pixel Canary model

hma_dialog_desc: Generates a custom HMA-OSS hiding profile from installed packages and merges it into the service configuration.
hma_force_regen_desc: Force config generation on every action run, even when Auto-Update HMA Config is enabled.
hma_version_old_text: This HMA-OSS service is older than oss-175, so it will not apply generated config changes automatically. Update the HMA-OSS Zygisk module, or open HMA-OSS and long-press the Home status card to apply the generated config.
control_toggle_auto_hma_desc: Regenerate the hiding profile in the background
auto_hma_desc: Regenerates the HMA-OSS hiding profile in the background. The action button skips HMA generation while this is enabled.
auto_hma_interval_desc: How often the background job regenerates the HMA profile. Minimum 1 hour.
auto_hma_info_text: Background updates only write the HMA-OSS config. Open HMA-OSS or reboot to apply the new profile. If the config is missing or empty, the action button regenerates it. Enable Always Re-Generate HMA-OSS Config in the HMA-OSS Configs page to force regeneration on every action run.
control_toggle_boot_hash_desc: Fix verified boot hash (ro.boot.vbmeta.digest) from TEE
boot_hash_info_desc: Fixes ro.boot.vbmeta.digest by syncing with hardware TEE attestation, or applies custom hash when set.
keybox_info_desc: Installed keybox identity, health, and file information.
keybox_info_not_installed_desc: Install a keybox to enable attestation.
setup_desc: Device, keystore backend, installed modules, and Specter feature configuration.
setup_unavailable_hint: Open Specter again or refresh the page.
keybox_watch_desc: Checks the installed keybox against the Specter catalog and replaces it when Auto Keybox is enabled.
keybox_refresh_desc: Checks the installed keybox and replaces it when revoked or expired.
keybox_refresh_interval_desc: Minimum 1 minute. Default 60 minutes. Opening the WebUI checks immediately.
keybox_refresh_replace_desc: Automatically install a new keybox when the current one is revoked or expired.
menu_hma_apps_desc: Manage per-app hiding states and blacklist interactively
ha_regenerate_confirm: This will re-scan all installed apps and rebuild HMA-OSS configuration. Custom selections will be overwritten. A backup will be saved.
